intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Seventeen who becomes its sergeant under Kaladin.

items.text: Pitt was a bridgeman in Bridge Seventeen, a notoriously motley crew. Like most bridgemen he just kept his head down, and resented Kaladin's training of his own crew. Once Sadeas's bridge crews were freed, Pitt was one of forty men chosen to train with Teft as potential sergeants. He apologised to Kaladin for his old attitude, was forgiven, and eagerly set about rebuilding his crew.

Bridge Seventeen was slow to adapt to being real soldiers, but a speech from Kaladin in the chasms inspired Pitt and his men, and Kaladin praised them on an inspection. The crew was among the first ready for patrol duty, and some of them guarded the Kholin leaders at the dueling arena.

appearance.text: He has strong features and short dark hair.

personality.text: Bridge duty broke his spirit, and he once hoped Kaladin's crew would fail when Kaladin gave its men pride. After his crew is freed from Sadeas, he becomes earnest and hopeful.
